notes.title: New demo of Grandpa's Bee Haven is now available!
notes.notes:
After months of dedication, we’re excited to share some major updates to Grandpa’s Bee Haven!

🛠️ We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, and here’s what’s new:
	•	We’ve migrated the entire game to a new engine(Unity) — smoother, better, cozier.
	•	Goodbye to windowed mode! The game now features a transparent overlay with click-through functionality, making it the perfect companion for multitaskers and chill background gamers.
	•	A brand-new saving system is here! No more losing progress — your bees will be right where you left them.
	•	🎨 We’ve also swapped out the main graphics to bring more wholesomeness and warmth.

Thanks for buzzing along with us — we can’t wait to share more soon. Grandpa would be proud. 💛

Stay wholesome!

notes.title: Grandpa’s Bee Haven's demo is now available!
notes.notes:
[b]Good News friends! 🐝[/b]

The [b]free demo[/b] for Grandpa’s Bee Haven is now available in Steam! 🐝 

Download the demo and start to build your beekeeping haven!  Our team would also love to hear your feedback and get Steam reviews!

Also, if you haven’t already, be sure to hit the green “[b]Add to Wishlist[/b]”🌟 button to support the game! Every wishlist helps us a ton.  Thanks! 💛
